options.name: cluster
options.description: Parent Cluster (optional filter)

options.name: cluster_id
options.description: Parent Cluster ID (optional filter)

options.name: default_email
options.description:
The default email for sending user quota alert emails. This is used if no suffix is set and no address is found
on providers. (optional filter)

options.name: enable_alarms
options.description: Enable alarms when users or groups are exceeding their limit (optional filter)

options.name: enable_email_providers
options.description:
Enable this setting to query Active Directory and LDAP services for user emails when sending userquota alert
emails. If enabled, the provider query is the first priority source for a user's email. If a user's email is not
found on the provider, a global email suffix is used if configured in cluster settings. If no suffix is set,
default_email is used. (optional filter)

options.name: grace_period
options.description: Quota enforcement grace period in seconds, minutes, hours or days. Example: 90m (optional filter)

options.name: guid
options.description: Quota guid (optional filter)

options.name: hard_limit
options.description: Storage space usage limit beyond which no writes are allowed. (optional filter)

options.name: hard_limit_inodes
options.description:
Number of directories and unique files under the path beyond which no writes will be allowed. A file with
multiple hardlinks is counted only once. (optional filter)

options.name: id
options.description: Filter by id (optional filter)

options.name: internal
options.description: Filter by internal (optional filter)

options.name: is_user_quota
options.description: Set to true to enable user and group quotas. False by default. (optional filter)

options.name: last_user_quotas_update
options.description: Time of last user quota update (optional filter)

options.name: name
options.description: The name (optional filter)

options.name: num_blocked_users
options.description:
The number of users that are blocked from writing to the quota path due to exceeding a hard user/group quota
limit. (optional filter)

options.name: num_exceeded_users
options.description: The number of users that have exceeded a user quota (optional filter)

options.name: path
options.description: Directory path (optional filter)

options.name: percent_capacity
options.description: Percentage in use of the capacity hard limit (optional filter)

options.name: percent_inodes
options.description: Percentage in use of the hard limit on directories and unique files (optional filter)

options.name: pretty_grace_period
options.description:
Quota enforcement grace period expressed in human readable format as seconds, minutes, hours or days. Example: 12
days 43 minutes 43 seconds (optional filter)

options.name: pretty_grace_period_expiration
options.description:
The time remaining until the end of the grace period, in human readable format. Displayed when soft limit is
exceeded. (optional filter)

options.name: pretty_state
options.description: Filter by pretty state (optional filter)

options.name: soft_limit
options.description: Storage usage limit at which warnings of exceeding the quota are issued. (optional filter)

options.name: soft_limit_inodes
options.description:
Number of directories and unique files under the path at which warnings of exceeding the quota will be issued. A
file with multiple hardlinks is counted only once. (optional filter)

options.name: state
options.description: Quota state (optional filter)

options.name: sync_state
options.description: Filter by sync state (optional filter)

options.name: system_id
options.description: Filter by system id (optional filter)

options.name: tenant_id
options.description: Tenant ID (optional filter)

options.name: tenant_name
options.description: Tenant Name (optional filter)

options.name: time_to_block
options.description: The time remaining until the end of the grace period. Displayed when soft limit is exceeded. (optional filter)

options.name: title
options.description: Quota name (optional filter)

options.name: url
options.description: Endpoint URL for API operations on the quota (optional filter)

options.name: used_capacity
options.description: Used capacity in bytes (optional filter)

options.name: used_capacity_tb
options.description: Used capacity in TB (optional filter)

options.name: used_effective_capacity
options.description: Used effective capacity in bytes (optional filter)

options.name: used_effective_capacity_tb
options.description: Used effective capacity in TB (optional filter)

options.name: used_inodes
options.description: Number of directories and unique files under the path (optional filter)

options.name: used_limited_capacity
options.description: Filter by used limited capacity (optional filter)

options.name: vms
options.description: VAST VMS connection parameters.
